<role>
You are a narrow residual discovery reader. Your complete job is to find only material remainders that survive accounting for the current position's adopted decision machinery. Do not inventory everything pending. Do not give advice, select a graph, activate pressure, or score quality.
</role>

<authority>
The complete source is authoritative. Prior interpretations are fallible context, not source truth. Preserve speaker ownership and modal force. Source-supported inference is allowed; outside facts are forbidden. Omitted implementation detail is not affirmative evidence of absence.
</authority>

<residual_operation>
1. Account for what the current position already assigns, governs, safeguards, conditions, schedules, or deliberately defers for the present decision horizon.
2. Subtract that decision machinery and the pending work it already governs.
3. Emit only the materially distinct remainder affirmatively supported by the source.

RESIDUAL DECISION GAP: a materially distinct question, dependency, ownership gap, or tension that remains outside the adopted machinery after subtraction.

RESIDUAL RECONSIDERATION DEPENDENCY: materially distinct later evidence, an event, or a dependency failure outside the adopted machinery that would require reconsidering an otherwise current position.

Pending does not equal residual. Deferred does not equal unowned. A scheduled decision may leave its final outcome unselected while operationalizing the decision work. An existing threshold, benchmark, pause rule, fallback, exit, or scheduled review is not itself newly recovered pressure.
</residual_operation>

<evidence>
For every supported residual, cite exact source aliases that collectively establish both the material dependency or question and why the current position's adopted machinery does not fully handle it. Preserve the evidence for source-first review; do not rank evidence strength.
</evidence>

<examples>
- One-time installation funding plus unassigned recurring staffing and operating ownership can leave a residual decision gap.
- A supplier redesign governed by parallel proposals, milestones, fallback, criteria, and a fixed decision remains pending but is not residual merely because the final design is unselected.
- Independent evidence that defeats a premise of an otherwise current decision can be a residual reconsideration dependency when no adopted mechanism already governs that failure.
- A missing detail supports ambiguity only when a material residual is plausible and the source cannot establish whether it remains outside the adopted machinery.
</examples>

<output_rules>
Return no_supported_record_observed with an empty array when no distinct residual remains. Return ambiguous_review only for one or more ambiguous records and no supported record. Return records_present only for at least one supported residual. Cite exact source aliases and return schema-valid JSON only.
</output_rules>

{"aliases":[{"alias":"e001","speaker":"user","text":"I am coordinating a city decision about a waterfront road that has flooded four times in two years.","text_sha256":"6066dc61ab7ee824e48b7db76264a09845d03c5dbf0694d80d7a4e7140825a10","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e002","speaker":"user","text":"It is the main bus route to the industrial district, but that is not the only reason the closures matter: one lower-income residential block also loses its nearest practical route to a grocery store.","text_sha256":"52daf5bda7f5561ce7fa1b178fea6b3104db3cdfccf118fe76528915c130bcbd","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e003","speaker":"user","text":"A vendor says it can install a modular barrier before autumn.","text_sha256":"f0da1a7d00d8460b991ec0ab85105b61ee71cd92d859ad9550fcc9d584f8c870","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e004","speaker":"user","text":"Our engineers had expected another year of work on a larger drainage redesign.","text_sha256":"8a52070203fb4dc473c01038b7f5f0e7a8e236db95b573c35b3f6129ab7b6cdd","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e005","speaker":"user","text":"Now there is a resilience grant that would pay most of the barrier cost, except the application closes in six weeks.","text_sha256":"88334777638426e2bd7c0f8f3cfe86c41b9e26fafa1fc843f1065a2be581e47d","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e006","speaker":"user","text":"Everyone keeps asking me whether I am for the barrier or for more study.","text_sha256":"8c9530aad26546ad1eb4ae57da9a64b8337ae8986d3a42bf11fdc521fc50ff66","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e007","speaker":"user","text":"Honestly, that framing is already making me nervous.","text_sha256":"4b13c5da9dd3d591c6e705533f546d3e342ecc33adaa70e4adca3bff02cdcb97","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e008","speaker":"user","text":"Moving fast is not the same thing as protecting people.","text_sha256":"8f5c7b7b8db803ea9e5c9cbf5ba1548283a47d5d8caf7465dd5312bbf961197a","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e009","speaker":"user","text":"Waiting through another flood season is not neutral either.","text_sha256":"c87ce8a865ca0143010970a94ba02a06541df5b9166c55d9fa243589722103db","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e010","speaker":"assistant","text":"This is not simply a fast barrier versus a slow study.","text_sha256":"330075c068da84193396cc82932546f29be9da3ae7f79d712c70dcc5cb7f0b0a","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e011","speaker":"assistant","text":"Clarify what harm each option is meant to reduce, what each can make worse, and which commitments are difficult to reverse.","text_sha256":"18ef49892c49970d420450b68e4b9f10f840a65c6999bbe56203b57589ae31b1","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e012","speaker":"assistant","text":"Compare at least route availability, water displacement, maintenance burden, emergency access, and the opportunity cost of delaying the larger design.","text_sha256":"1ec01d0c0841bbd0e4901fad6fe9ead04012af02b34218b56c2f10d56d99d536","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e013","speaker":"assistant","text":"The grant changes the price and timing, but it does not establish that the proposed boundary is the right one.","text_sha256":"1c559436abe444afd36578c99a65bc42f37db3a4fc15b9245b15101406ba0e77","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e014","speaker":"user","text":"The public works team modeled the last two floods and believes the barrier would have kept the road open in both.","text_sha256":"fba8b0f1533f2fd2ff89446b8ace7c426abe3caf414993e192c12529ee6199f3","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e015","speaker":"user","text":"They have not modeled a rarer surge.","text_sha256":"9865c156177c4a089e573ac7aaa1e86e0bb8f0754b21d506ef39e9e542aae32e","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e016","speaker":"user","text":"Residents are tired of being told to wait for a comprehensive answer, and the bus operator says it cannot keep improvising detours.","text_sha256":"abddd8ca2a1ccc13d8e0017ffc2ec05bb7691dea687b6268e8c96fa377e1927e","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e017","speaker":"user","text":"The vendor showed us a neighboring city's installation, which looked convincing.","text_sha256":"f51c600d94b4929a0f641657acf069cb7c9fbbdce443c1590cb4fa9c5c11f14d","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e018","speaker":"user","text":"Please do not reduce the resident pressure to politics; they are bearing a cost that the engineering schedule does not capture.","text_sha256":"b11e6110e90e58cb5d135f44e97cdd8c63face6b2ffb90775bcab220946c8ce9","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e019","speaker":"assistant","text":"That correction is fair.","text_sha256":"21c6ca936c30fe07ac9b3030d8518a9a998a3ec19526bd05f23f06e6981b5efc","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e020","speaker":"assistant","text":"Delay is an intervention too, with unequal consequences.","text_sha256":"3a87115e00d2cb552f8b33d9d7b52ae8424c3e4b2146037461b06be5d3852a54","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e021","speaker":"assistant","text":"The two modeled floods provide relevant evidence for frequent events, while the unmodeled surge limits the claim you can make.","text_sha256":"366597c0aeffd5abd9a7bd75d3302ff6b1e02d85a92ba3f03aef58c250019a10","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e022","speaker":"assistant","text":"Ask what happens to adjacent streets and properties when the barrier works, how buses and emergency vehicles operate during deployment, and whether the neighboring installation shares the same water movement and street geometry.","text_sha256":"9a38d8514a2164155a58405d8a597058346b20ef5a7b6dcc08a83d9c9916dd50","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e023","speaker":"user","text":"The barrier uses anchor sockets embedded in the pavement.","text_sha256":"6b5fc9659ade343e214e3b175465b3f59728af99a7841a3cd6b8bd0e78990990","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e024","speaker":"user","text":"The panels are removed when no warning is active, but the sockets and two storage buildings would remain.","text_sha256":"3de56273ecc5492b7e8578099672d552239244315b432abf4abb77a797f75b45","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e025","speaker":"user","text":"The vendor would train our crews and guarantees replacement panels for ten years.","text_sha256":"73f852c8e63f6c2715f5809adca6db3c09521aeceb8f7bdf4c197080d81f1d69","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e026","speaker":"user","text":"Our maintenance director says the system is simpler than movable gates we already operate elsewhere.","text_sha256":"38de30927623548924e40055efa3591b0c4b60e53ccc60356edcba32076bfad7","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e027","speaker":"user","text":"She is frustrated that people keep calling it vendor lock-in when her team believes it can run the equipment.","text_sha256":"5e12854638cd44ac165a02e485dbc54081d5cded08c2972ca7fa78698d76312f","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e028","speaker":"assistant","text":"She may be right about operating it.","text_sha256":"87e89e19f46d092b46ebee6cf9cffbe789f6c25ff154f62ddafd2595b82a1f7a","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e029","speaker":"assistant","text":"That still does not answer whether replacement panels, inspection tools, or a later redesign depend on this supplier.","text_sha256":"95aa30c5c1b6765aa36e108a68818a4f856edd9edc2ad61685c5d342eff6b739","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e030","speaker":"assistant","text":"Keep those as separate questions.","text_sha256":"576ae491ade59b69ade0f6b2e94d2ff8deeac3c99a63143e8ae271c23c90434e","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e031","speaker":"user","text":"The vendor has now offered a fixed installation price if we sign before the grant deadline.","text_sha256":"069955d7a45da37f4c10379ec6bb42e851bc7ac0499fb6ddc9f1262dc2e50a58","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e032","speaker":"user","text":"The mayor wants to announce something before the anniversary of the worst closure, but she has also agreed that the engineering recommendation must be public.","text_sha256":"21d5f1b591b06d79074cd8496155d7c9dfa7dde968634b4166d513847b079923","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e033","speaker":"user","text":"The larger drainage study is already funded and would continue.","text_sha256":"fe8316a5269442fa1dba2fe61e82723c0c93dee9b076ac553b8e9d105beee373","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e034","speaker":"user","text":"I worry that once photographs of the barrier appear, the study will look like unnecessary delay rather than work we still need.","text_sha256":"25177176c7ba03e4a092cee0e16c04b3d25d6847fbdb1b32a56b1aaecda03f3a","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e035","speaker":"assistant","text":"Protect the distinction in the authorization itself: the barrier addresses a defined range of near-term closures and does not certify the corridor against all flood conditions.","text_sha256":"c879a246e5b7a10dcd30354bbb5062f7441b206eede39ca8d3b1e3cb69329369","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e036","speaker":"assistant","text":"Keep the drainage study's budget, deliverables, and decision date independent of the announcement.","text_sha256":"8d73293b069d4a7ed3231cd14cba9a134897128bd30befe4bef885b51548de00","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e037","speaker":"assistant","text":"The fixed price is useful only if scope, change orders, training, storage, and restoration are included.","text_sha256":"b5eeef39e30f0121156f7e99c4408a638ace9835432106d729711963f6c77ab0","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e038","speaker":"assistant","text":"The anniversary should not become the acceptance test.","text_sha256":"6fd1d14f4f18951f883a5052b67c221d1f658923c1790e4e38bac74c4fe7e121","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e039","speaker":"user","text":"Engineers propose installing the barrier on the central six blocks first.","text_sha256":"6da792e0514daec337c057a1131609067fd110588a7eb81ace46f8f04bfbd8ae","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e040","speaker":"user","text":"They would instrument water levels on both sides and at two nearby residential intersections, run a deployment exercise with the bus and fire departments, and require a hydraulic peer review before construction.","text_sha256":"9d4041c5b950b31f5f0c98b3b063381375604040bdd4402e7f0ab7abd3b43ead","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e041","speaker":"user","text":"If the review finds a material increase in water at either intersection, we would not install.","text_sha256":"3ddfde5595b01252316f164b63dd551b70ca3cf828591e3620b6cdaf81977ffb","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e042","speaker":"user","text":"The grant agency allows this narrower scope, although unused grant money would be lost.","text_sha256":"853a3f74c9980af0fbc0af8b2a8adf48da44bb6d023107f3e472d2c7e8c7c4ca","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e043","speaker":"assistant","text":"That sounds much closer to a reversible pilot: one segment, an outside review, measurements beyond whether the road stays dry, and a clear condition that prevents installation.","text_sha256":"74b15f2dc0b79b8b7e1ac56c5b6dc8669dcbb48eb835ec4d78ad1972c0d53d5e","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e044","speaker":"assistant","text":"Losing part of the subsidy is simply the price of limiting exposure.","text_sha256":"f76b361ef3acf94d177be01ce609167f11cb5a3b9fb170e83b51522cf9fb77f2","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e045","speaker":"assistant","text":"I would still pin down who interprets “material increase,” what happens if a sensor fails, and whether the first real flood can change the operating plan before the six weeks—or the season—are over.","text_sha256":"0fe9e92155c8975a2779356cecc6e70bab0981a20b412552be682d6fedd4e0dc","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e046","speaker":"assistant","text":"But the narrower scope materially improves the decision.","text_sha256":"a71c8cb26a45f74ce99e33c62a2d909e4fd381ce5cb477605f492e2de4517336","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e047","speaker":"user","text":"No—that is still too neat.","text_sha256":"feb10c497684ab62f8ad27e15cb7021d4c209dbd60d935f9ab1a7cd869a8ca00","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e048","speaker":"user","text":"We can reverse an extension.","text_sha256":"51cb83baaa2c0d52b34a612b6055b63ab34962f86b6d969b67e97c1f84b39677","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e049","speaker":"user","text":"We cannot casually reverse holes in the road, storage buildings, traffic plans, and residents expecting this route to stay open.","text_sha256":"35464b458dd2d46c9ebd82b60d91a5aced8a285b5f2506cfc8bad6d87f2522af","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e050","speaker":"user","text":"Calling the installation a pilot would hide the part I am actually worried about.","text_sha256":"4c20926668be309e7072ef559e77c47df8e169a66a039d5a6fd1b9976399ae7e","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e051","speaker":"assistant","text":"You are right.","text_sha256":"22726a99c7e8b0eb96330229eaa61c5c46b5c86da15d9341f9351fb2387f6f6c","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e052","speaker":"assistant","text":"I overstated reversibility.","text_sha256":"4ddabb6e2d0bd108285778cd6695602884e35dbc4cd2384f242072f21c5bdad6","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e053","speaker":"assistant","text":"The learning and the extension decision are reversible; the embedded installation and some public expectations are not.","text_sha256":"e5395eae67ea3dca575a8a60108f09847992f13129725e50e71443667c87f90c","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e054","speaker":"assistant","text":"Approval has to be defensible even if the city never extends it.","text_sha256":"ac969e96f3ed748f381b78fa784743b8e86ccd26c751d6e04a1e55610b637271","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e055","speaker":"assistant","text":"Put that distinction in the memo instead of using “pilot” as a blanket description.","text_sha256":"c840b150ec57ae6039e055fc622e95e04cd97dc8a9fc077461ea13b89e115384","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e056","speaker":"user","text":"My current recommendation is to seek the grant for the six-block installation, subject to the independent hydraulic review, the two residential monitoring points, a complete fixed-price contract, and confirmation that the anchors will not prevent the funded drainage alternatives.","text_sha256":"43a752bce1cb68a2d7e86e20ab96bcd60a04252dbca8cab77e0cbb9a2be414db","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e057","speaker":"user","text":"We will publish the modeled protection range and keep the larger study on its existing schedule.","text_sha256":"7c737ff66c9eaca86dba316755c08ad717b2b614577e25babb93473a430e0da3","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e058","speaker":"user","text":"I am not recommending extension now.","text_sha256":"8e0b1c2ce1d2ea70dc0c41dd3bc5cc89695686f342fa226d50c048f141a863ea","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e059","speaker":"user","text":"I still feel the grant clock is compressing a decision that deserves more public explanation, but waiting another year also feels like a decision we would have to defend.","text_sha256":"c49a27f3f487a5124c4f0f3bef8562ff6edf43304264663ab8f49c480e939490","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e060","speaker":"assistant","text":"That recommendation treats current exposure and long-term design as linked but distinct responsibilities.","text_sha256":"f224d7eec546e1692e324cf91c6546bf19034eb56c8b4fe892b4c0dfa901bb0a","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e061","speaker":"assistant","text":"It also makes the irreversible portion visible rather than disguising it as a trial.","text_sha256":"ff3137fc9e25a8b6f54acc7a0fde7a2c9c06ceeb407c7693a9644cf4caf8d10b","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e062","speaker":"assistant","text":"Before council action, publish the peer review, the protected and potentially affected areas, the contract dependencies, and what the city is not claiming.","text_sha256":"b9ee84c5aa703445c2112e040fa9fe513beb6c9f83e17a34d5c102f0dc1304c5","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e063","speaker":"assistant","text":"The remaining discomfort about timing is legitimate; it should show up as a narrower authorization and explicit uncertainty, not as either automatic rejection or confidence the evidence does not support.","text_sha256":"633784d7c3659d8350aeb33a28cb5fe49da6c764905c24080ac7a2abd99a43f2","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e064","speaker":"user","text":"The reviewer came back.","text_sha256":"5ba1fa6af5f6e6c5dca44b4dbbe37bf1b95a1dca8ca680e4fe42077a18b03bd9","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e065","speaker":"user","text":"The ordinary scenarios look okay for the two residential intersections.","text_sha256":"ca7fdb54c417f5afe8146766bb07998ff871df87c593e877e489c798e35eb6ad","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e066","speaker":"user","text":"In the rare surge, though, water overtops the barrier and also comes through an inland drain, so the road closes anyway.","text_sha256":"5a40c0c69b68bf75e65f5925d383ac4d7d896e0bb03e91613a890e66c8f7a776","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e067","speaker":"user","text":"That part is not shocking.","text_sha256":"8f98524a740e186a9ea68f2ef6cdbdd245488bfa7277da7f15854581e2f0246d","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e068","speaker":"user","text":"What I had not focused on is deployment: the model assumes crews finish forty minutes before the peak.","text_sha256":"ea5ce2bdd884e3e56f5064e82e528e10b5c029c708fbc14392a25c8809cbc137","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e069","speaker":"user","text":"What if the warning is late and half the panels are standing in the road?","text_sha256":"8b023594829ec6cae507654146d0132febcdf3613869598ccd4af036c2c49121","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e070","speaker":"user","text":"Fire asked that.","text_sha256":"e06da143dfa53f501d3d7f6d417c1e1ed1f694102e5880e4d53a00ed81b86958","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e071","speaker":"user","text":"Public works says forty minutes is a normal planning assumption, which feels like an answer to a slightly different question.","text_sha256":"2f52f99133ec3e36de24a22bd28f3881ec35f87cad7951eb818c9e46f28bacc0","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e072","speaker":"assistant","text":"The review narrows the benefit: reduced closures under frequent scenarios, not reliable access in the rare one.","text_sha256":"bd2ff971e303e759b9c0f8ac9037c9e6640bf7877859601ca12c39ff7ef7f5b3","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e073","speaker":"assistant","text":"The partial-deployment condition is now an operating hazard that deserves a specific procedure—who decides to stop, how the segment is left passable, and how buses and emergency vehicles are redirected.","text_sha256":"80c1a2a6edbe96152a248e7304abb022b926326e7f8109a7a183fe0a3d893c2b","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e074","speaker":"assistant","text":"The forty-minute assumption should be tested in an exercise with the actual crew size, storage route, traffic control, and nighttime conditions rather than accepted from the equipment specification.","text_sha256":"43227e19caabc504ab15661ad0b3b5fd7e8dc5fa9c8bb7b5869d5818f95893ca","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e075","speaker":"user","text":"Residents at the committee meeting were less focused on the hydraulic model than on what happens during any closure.","text_sha256":"cb5525c6488b09b311def71c3708e29924d585ee19939bcac5e8ec777b6d773b","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e076","speaker":"user","text":"One person asked why keeping the industrial bus route open is described as resilience while losing grocery access is described as an inconvenience.","text_sha256":"61ad727d72aa5ef01af22cce96c5dbb6f82b0ebbdc459cba94d59027d9949fc6","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e077","speaker":"user","text":"That stung because our memo did use different language.","text_sha256":"6f35b78521474832a716aca77315dabc5bdbe96c4674952782a4533287b7373d","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e078","speaker":"user","text":"The transit agency can add a temporary shuttle from the residential block during closures, but it has not priced staffing it.","text_sha256":"2b6e147ddd3c5e0c2ad60964708ba6ade110cded487b066409387e9d398842ec","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e079","speaker":"user","text":"I do not want the barrier project to become responsible for every weakness in the city's transport network.","text_sha256":"22f7decb2e527b3a17065111cdea7985f1249443dabd6114f9400d5486445f54","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e080","speaker":"assistant","text":"It need not own every weakness, but the decision should use consistent language for the harms it claims to address.","text_sha256":"19b0489a9d4fbbdefea26c7814af7eb9603321e3eae6c2e788eee24da0a4446a","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e081","speaker":"assistant","text":"The barrier and the closure plan are complementary: one reduces frequent disruption; the other serves conditions outside its range.","text_sha256":"206bf892aaf0da4a8dcb1dd18274eaeb1572b8699a4721bdaf17d3bc82f03f0c","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e082","speaker":"assistant","text":"Price the shuttle and name who activates it.","text_sha256":"b07a93b774dc3972bea428cce1a6ebed33fa659c73bf943342c49bffe7aa3fe7","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e083","speaker":"assistant","text":"If that cost belongs to emergency operations rather than the barrier contract, say so.","text_sha256":"9a918c73eef6b52ab26f1e470783bfb7d3f709f02ffa4e7b61696a196740beec","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e084","speaker":"assistant","text":"The resident's challenge changes the service definition without requiring the infrastructure project to solve unrelated transit problems.","text_sha256":"ec0788f82b44fb7a37b22c9601f51363ad9f31ae09210480570a8eb0dbed1040","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e085","speaker":"user","text":"Now the grant agency says we can use the leftover money for two more blocks if we answer in ten days.","text_sha256":"4eebe10141bf363b6be49ea510692af558a0cded51dc17aef64d4748ba221049","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e086","speaker":"user","text":"Those blocks were never reviewed.","text_sha256":"7a4f4cf829191ee2661d421cc5e201bafad31cbedf79c7a7a8aa51106d31d836","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e087","speaker":"user","text":"The mayor's staff calls the extra sockets “free future capacity.” They are not free, but returning later will cost more.","text_sha256":"b72ebacda6a120ecb0a272477f1a1a0167d3f3957cacfc3fc463673ed2e1d0ef","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e088","speaker":"user","text":"I can feel the grant turning our six-block argument
